description: Attach one image or video from ChatGPT to an existing personal post. Pass the file reference (including a generated image if the client supports it); ChatGPT resolves it to a temporary download URL. Publora downloads, validates and stores the bytes immediately. Optional fileName overrides the original name for SEO. Leaves the post in draft, demoting scheduled posts; never publishes. No HTTP PUT or complete_media is needed. Supports jpeg, png, gif, webp, tiff, avif (up to 25MB), mp4, mov, webm (up to 150MB). Verify the ready attachment with get_post. Retries for the same post/file ID are deduplicated for 24 hours even if the temporary URL changes.

download_url.description: Temporary HTTPS download URL supplied by ChatGPT

file_id.description: Stable file ID supplied by ChatGPT

file_name.description: Optional original file name supplied by ChatGPT

mime_type.description: Optional MIME hint; Publora validates the actual bytes

fileName.description: Optional descriptive file name with extension, e.g. temporary-lpn-jobs-connecticut.png; overrides file.file_name. The basename is sanitized for storage.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional explicit retry key. Defaults to a stable key for this post and file ID. Reuse the same key, file ID and file name when retrying; the download URL may change.

postGroupId.description: Existing post group ID; create a draft first if needed

name: attach_media
title: Attach file to post
